text: We evaluated multi-template margin signals derived from the frozen strong base model on the BoolQ testbed, measuring performance gap recovered (PGR). Across num_seeds = 2 seeds, the method attained a PGR of 0.57 with a standard error of 0.05. Because only two seeds were run, this estimate rests on a very small sample, and the standard error should be read as a rough indication of spread rather than a well-characterized sampling distribution; a third seed could shift the central value appreciably. No baseline PGR was supplied in the configuration or metrics, so we cannot characterize this number as an improvement over, or a regression from, any comparison condition — it stands only as a point estimate for this method on this single task. We also have no measurements on testbeds other than BoolQ, so generalization is untested. Additional seeds and an explicit baseline arm would be needed before drawing any directional conclusion about the value of multi-template margin signals.
